rounds: I can usually tell when something online is a scam.
Influencers should be legally responsible for the products they promote.
Chatbots should always have to tell you that they’re not human.
I would let an AI read all my emails if it answered half of them for me.
Social media companies should pay back people who lose money to scam adverts on their sites.
AI will create more jobs than it destroys.
Anonymous accounts should be banned on social media.
Most people would be happier without social media.
